steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend synchronous sessions from anywhere, learn from active certified practitioners, and cover the full PMBOK® Guide framework. This formal education satisfies PMI's mandatory contact-hour requirement and prepares you for exam content.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: File your PMP application directly with PMI, documenting your education and project experience. Pay the associated PMI exam fee upon approval. Granite PM Academy's support team can guide you through the submission process to ensure accuracy and prevent delays.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over the standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your PMP active. Pursue ongoing training, attend webinars, or contribute to project-management initiatives. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses to support your continued professional growth.
